description: This file defines the DTV class within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace, including nested Notification class, and declares methods and members related to Digital TV (DTV) functionalities, notifications, and JSON-RPC interfaces.

classes.name: DTV
classes.description: Main class implementing DTV plugin functionalities, including initialization, deinitialization, and various getter/setter methods for TV services and configurations.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection notifications and service events, such as search status and service updates.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DTV plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: GetNumberOfCountries
methods.description: Retrieves the number of supported countries.

methods.name: GetCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported countries.

methods.name: GetNumberOfServices
methods.description: Gets total number of TV services.

methods.name: GetServiceList
methods.description: Retrieves list of services based on index.

methods.name: GetNowNextEvents
methods.description: Fetches current and next events for a service.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Gets status of a service or component.

methods.name: GetServiceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a service.

methods.name: GetExtendedEventInfo
methods.description: Gets extended info for an event.

methods.name: GetJsonServiceType
methods.description: Converts service type to JSON enum.

methods.name: GetJsonRunningStatus
methods.description: Converts running status to JSON enum.

methods.name: CreateJsonForService
methods.description: Creates JSON object for a service.

methods.name: CreateJsonForEITEvent
methods.description: Creates JSON object for an EIT event.
